settings.relation: Born into a family of musicians, I started my musical journey playing drums. After being part of numerous bands, ranging from psychedelic rock to stoner and punk, I felt the need to integrate melody with percussion. In 2012 I discovered the handpan, where I brought my fast, direct and percussive drumming background.
settings.quote: My Ayasa is my rock, a companion through a thousand adventures. What I love most is its perfect balance, precision, and the warmth of its sound.
settings.relation_more:
Over the years I have performed in theatres, concerts and festivals all over the world. I've also developed a passion for street music, which has allowed me to create a unique style characterised by a combination of handpan and digital percussion.
